newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka navy attacks rebel "Sea Tiger" base.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka navy attacks rebel "Sea Tiger" base.

text.p: The Sri Lankan navy attacked a Tamil Tiger guerrilla sea base on the island's northeastern coast early on Wednesday, destroying a large number of rebel boats, military officials in the east said.

Several navy fast attack craft and gunboats took part in the pre-dawn attack, which caused heavy damage to a Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam's (LTTE) "Sea Tigers" base near the fishing village of Chalai in northeastern Mullaitivu district, they said.
"There were more than 40 (rebel) boats on shore. Most of them should have been damaged by the attack," an official told Reuters.
He said they were unsure of rebel casualties. There were no naval casualties, he added.
An LTTE spokesman in London was not immediately available for comment.
Sea Tigers form the naval wing of the LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east.
The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year.
